verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party natural-language command interface for operating LangSmith, such as an in-app assistant or a chat-driven control surface. The official MCP server (langsmith-probe-4) is evidence for the separate MCP-server story and does not transfer here. LangSmith Engine (langsmith-docs-6) is automated issue detection, not natural-language operation, so it is an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
